Hi Alice / team —

Quick MAP update and owner commitments for this week. Short summary first, then action list.

Summary:
- Environment: private trial VPC provisioned in us-west-2; connectivity established to Alpine test subnet.
- Eval plan: 12k synthetic sessions + 2k production-sampled prompts scheduled for sanity runs on Tue.
- Acceptance criteria: 95th pctl latency <= 120ms and accuracy (intent match) >= 92% on the evaluation set.

Current blockers to close POC:
1) Networking ACL — Alpine needs one additional cidr block whitelisted (CIDR: 10.42.128.0/22).
   Owner: Karthik Iyer (see action below). Due: 2027-05-28 EOD.
2) SOC2 evidence request — Alpine procurement needs a few artifact files for security review.
   Owner: Marissa Cole. Due: 2027-05-29.
3) Eval dataset labeling gap — we noticed ~150 prompts missing ground truth tags.
   Owner: Mina Haddad / Alpine data lead. Due: 2027-05-30.

Action items (owners & comms):
- Karthik: Confirm firewall rules and push the whitelist; share Jira key and expected ETA. (Karthik: please reply with the rule ID.)
- Marissa: Share SOC2 summary + retention policy doc; attach evidence bundle to HubSpot record.
- Alice/Alpine: Confirm the final acceptance criteria above or propose edits by EOD Monday.
- Mina: I'll run the first evaluation sweep once the network is green and report perf numbers.

Attachments: MAP_v2.xlsx (owner tracker), POC-eval-criteria.pdf
Related: HubSpot deal link attached below.

Proposed next sync: Tue 2027-05-31 10:00am PT (15 min) to review first sweep numbers and any remaining blockers.

Thanks —
Mina
